import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
la_geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-118.7, 33.6, -118.0, 34.3])  # Los Angeles area

def get_no2_data(year):
    """Get mean NO2 for Oct 1-23 period"""
    collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \
        .filterDate(f'{year}-10-01', f'{year}-10-24') \
        .filterBounds(la_geom) \
        .filter(ee.Filter.gt('qa_value', 0.5))  # Quality filter
    
    if collection.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None, 0
    
    mean_img = collection.mean()
    
    # Get pixel count and mean value
    stats = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True),
        geometry=la_geom,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    result = stats.getInfo()
    no2_mean = result.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
    pixel_count = result.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count', 0)
    
    return no2_mean, pixel_count

# 2. Data Acquisition & Processing
years = [2018, 2019, 2021]
results = {}

for year in years:
    no2_mean, pixel_count = get_no2_data(year)
    results[year] = {'mean': no2_mean, 'pixels': pixel_count}
    print(f"{year}: NO2={no2_mean:.6f}, Pixels={pixel_count}")

# 3. Check for data issues
if any(results[year]['mean'] is None for year in [2018, 2019, 2021]):
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif any(results[year]['pixels'] == 0 for year in [2018, 2019, 2021]):
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif any(results[year]['mean'] is None or results[year]['mean'] < 0 for year in [2018, 2019, 2021]):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    # 4. Comparison logic
    baseline = (results[2018]['mean'] + results[2019]['mean']) / 2
    no2_2021 = results[2021]['mean']
    
    print(f"Baseline (2018+2019 avg): {baseline:.6f}")
    print(f"2021 NO2: {no2_2021:.6f}")
    
    if no2_2021 < baseline:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
